baseline.title: Ronald Reagan: Farewell Address to the Nation

flaws.context: sentence 1 of 4, middle of the sentence
flaws.fix: Tighten these words to about 1.3 s; keep the pauses at punctuation and close the gaps inside the phrase.
flaws.label: DRAG (recipe name)
flaws.measure: speech time of the five-word window at the peak, s (reference scaled to your overall tempo)
flaws.text: Slower here: 2.22-5.12 s ('the stairs from this office is'). The word alignment measures 1.84 s of speech in the peak window of 5 words ('stairs from this office is'); relative to the reference rendition it took 1.29 s at your overall tempo, 43% longer (1.7x the threshold; flagged above 23%). The span is approximate: this measure uses five-word windows. Costs 1.5 points of the reference-relative delivery index; score with this penalty removed: 95.5.
flaws.why: "A recitation that is at a too slow or hurried pace, poorly projected, has a distracting rhythm or monotone delivery will obscure a poem's meaning for the audience." (Poetry Out Loud Judge's Guide 2021-22)

flaws.context: sentence 2 of 4, middle of the sentence; punctuation after 'I': none
flaws.fix: Carry 'I have' on one breath; move the breath to 'live.'.
flaws.label: PAUSE_INTRUSIVE (recipe name)
flaws.measure: silent pause at the word boundary, s
flaws.text: Longer pause than the reference after 'I' at 11.00 s. The word alignment measures 0.59 s of silence between 'I' and 'have'; the reference holds 0.00 s and the transcript has no punctuation here (1.8x the threshold; flagged when 0.32 s longer). Costs 2.5 points of the reference-relative delivery index; score with this penalty removed: 96.5.
flaws.why: "Decide whether the pauses come in suitable places for the poem." (Poetry Out Loud Judge's Guide 2021-22)

flaws.context: sentence 4 of 4, middle of the sentence
flaws.fix: Compare the spectral-change contour with the reference; this proxy does not measure intelligibility.
flaws.label: MUMBLE (recipe name)
flaws.measure: MFCC delta magnitude over the five-word window at the peak (reference scaled by your overall difference)
flaws.text: Lower spectral change: 25.50-27.26 s ('can see past the Jefferson to'). Spectral change per frame is 1.07 against 2.44 at your overall level, 56% lower relative to the reference rendition (1.7x the threshold; flagged above 38%). The span is approximate: this measure uses five-word windows. Costs 2.0 points of the reference-relative delivery index; score with this penalty removed: 96.0.
flaws.why: "Was enunciation clear?" (UIL Texas Extemporaneous criteria); a rubric context only, not evidence that this proxy measures enunciation.

notices: Regime R1: the participant is derived from the baseline performance; 7 dimensions are enabled.

Flags are acoustic departures from reference features; pattern names describe the measured evidence, not a diagnosis. Timing is word-boundary resolution, except evidence spans: a silence or a held sound inside a word comes from 10 ms frame measures, and inserted material or a voiced run in a gap comes from the 20 ms speech-recogniser decode.
Word time is unscored: on unedited copies of the training speeches its measured word times changed too much to set a threshold, so no word-time detector is available for these edits.
Ending is unscored: in the dataset build most rising-ending edits did not raise the measured ending by 1 semitone, so too few ending edits remain to set and test a threshold.
